notes.title: BULLET SOUL INFINITE BURST Ver1.2
notes.content:
Today's update includes:
[list][*] [b]Changed default sound settings[/b]
This should fix sound balance issues.
[*] [b]Changed default controller settings[/b]
This should fix the issue some people had with the analog stick not registering diagonals.
[*] [b]Fix for mouse cursor displaying in full screen[/b]
The mouse cursor will no longer appear in full screen mode.
[/list] 

Thanks for all your support of Bullet Soul Infinite Burst!

notes.title: Bullet Soul Infinite Burst Caravan Mode Launch Contest!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29843852/80d90cf40e2fbfad4485261dcf6d1c733543b6c6.png[/img]

[h1]To celebrate Bullet Soul Infinite Burst coming to Steam, we are holding a Caravan Mode Launch contest![/h1]

[b]What is Caravan mode?[/b]
Caravan mode is a “score attack” sequence, where you rack up as many points as possible within two minutes.

[b]Rules:[/b]
- The contest will run during the first week of the game's release (contest will end 8/6 at 10pm EST)
- To enter your score into the contest, just play Caravan Mode and upload your score OR take a screenshot of the score screen and tweet your screenshot @MagesSteam during the launch week 
-  The highest score for EACH character will receive an [b]official SIGNED Bullet Soul poster![/b]
- The player with the most common digits in a row (222,222,222 for example) will also receive an [b]official Bullet Soul poster signed by the dev![/b]
- Only one prize per person ;)

We put together some Caravan Mode tips [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/544580/announcements/detail/1330100338746427313] here! [/url]
